topic: Safety precautions to be observed in Magazines, Ready use lockers temperature limits and magazine log.
syllabus_extract: Safety precautions to be observed in Magazines, Ready use lockers temperature limits and magazine log.
specific_objectives: 28.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the need for explosive regulation

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Inspection of Magazine Log and verification of temperature gauge readings against limits.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of explosive regulations?
Why are magazines and ready-use lockers classified as restricted areas?
What are the standard temperature limits for storing explosives?

development.content:
Need for explosive regulation
Safety precautions in magazines
Safety precautions in ready-use lockers

Temperature limits for storage
Effects of temperature extremes
Monitoring and recording procedures

Magazine log requirements
Entry and exit recording
Incident reporting protocols

summary_questions: Explain the consequences of exceeding temperature limits in a magazine.
Describe the correct procedure for recording an entry in the magazine log.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the site selection criteria for fusing bombs and depth charges as covered in the next lesson plan.
